files.name: main.py
files.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("sales.csv")
df["revenue"] = df["units"] * df["unit_price"]

pivot = df.pivot_table(
    index="region", columns="category", values="revenue",
    aggfunc="sum", fill_value=0,
)
print(pivot.round(0))

# Bảng tần suất
print(pd.crosstab(df["region"], df["category"]))

# melt: từ dạng "rộng" sang "dài"
wide = pd.DataFrame({"name": ["An", "Binh"], "math": [8, 6], "physics": [9, 7]})
long = wide.melt(id_vars="name", var_name="subject", value_name="score")
print(long)

prompt.en: Build a pivot table named pivot: rows are region, columns are category, values are the SUM of revenue (pivot_table, aggfunc="sum", fill_value=0).

import pandas as pd

wide = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["An", "Binh", "Chi"],
    "math": [8, 6, 10],
    "physics": [9, 7, 9],
})
long = wide.melt(id_vars="name", var_name="subject", value_name="score")
print(long)
